items.t: Accenture (ACN) Following WSIB Win Has An Undervalued Narrative To Defend
items.sum: Accenture (ACN) is back in focus after Ontario's Workplace Safety and Insurance Board reported that a multiyear, Accenture-led digital overhaul cut employer registration times from days to under ten minutes. Those wins with Ontario's WSIB and Mondelez come as Accenture's share price has pulled back 2.35% in the last day and 2.52% over the past week, following a sharp 30 day share price gain of 21.
